pdpa.title: Data Privacy Consent
pdpa.description: We collect and process your personal data for recruitment purposes under applicable data protection laws (PDPA Thailand / Decree 13 Vietnam / UU PDP Indonesia). Your data will be retained for 2 years or until consent is withdrawn.
pdpa.page_subtitle: Manage your personal data, exports, and consent history under PDPA / GDPR.
pdpa.settings_desc: Export or delete your personal data. View consent history.
pdpa.export_desc: Download a complete copy of your personal data in JSON format. This includes your profile, applications, documents, and consent records.
pdpa.delete_desc: Anonymize your personal data. PII fields will be replaced with anonymized values. Non-PII business records (application history, audit logs) will be retained for operational continuity.
pdpa.delete_warning: This action is irreversible. Your name, email, phone, and other personal identifiers will be permanently anonymized.
pdpa.delete_confirm_message: This will permanently anonymize your personal data. Your name, email, phone and other PII will be replaced with anonymized values. This action cannot be undone.
pdpa.categories_desc: Overview of data categories stored about you.
pdpa.consent_history_desc: Timeline of your consent records. Download receipts for your records.
